title: Power Pages: plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code edits traditional sites
summary: Hold: the automation row lists command names without the required arguments, so readers cannot run the calls as printed. The briefing also turns the roadmap's listed cloud into an unsupported exclusion of other clouds. The Visual Studio Code Download and Upload actions are documented; the automatic path warning is not a substantive error.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: GitHub usage, including GitHub Copilot, can be billed through the Azure subscription linked to the GitHub organisation.
claims.quote: Each GitHub organization is linked to a specific Azure subscription for billing purposes. All GitHub usage from that organization — including GitHub Copilot and GitHub Actions — flows to that subscription.

claims.claim: Claude Code's billing depends on the service it is configured to use.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing, so idle deployments don't incur charges. ... Without this variable, Claude Code uses the default Anthropic API.

claims.claim: Learn documents a Claude Code configuration using Microsoft Foundry that requires a paid Azure subscription.
claims.quote: To use Claude models in Microsoft Foundry, you must have a paid Azure subscription with a billing account in a country or region where Anthropic offers the models for purchase.

claims.claim: Power Platform Tools exposes Download and Upload by right-clicking an active site under Explorer > Power Pages Actions > Active Sites.
claims.quote: Power Pages Actions is available ... in the Explorer sidebar ... Right-click on Active Sites ... Upload: Uploads local changes back to your environment. ... Download: Downloads the site content to a local folder for offline editing.

claims.claim: The printed automation call 'pac pages download / pac pages upload / pac pages upload-code-site' supplies the calls for downloading and uploading site content and code.
claims.quote: Required Parameters for pages download: --path ... --webSiteId ... Required Parameters for pages upload: --path ... Required Parameters for pages upload-code-site: --rootPath
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api.call and its rendered counterpart with 'pac pages download --path <download-folder> --webSiteId <site-guid> --modelVersion <model-version>; pac pages upload --path <site-folder> --modelVersion <model-version>'. The cited reference documents these arguments. Remove upload-code-site from this traditional-site row rather than presenting the SPA operation as another equivalent.

claims.claim: The Visual Studio Code control is a developer UI rather than a plugin-specific tenant switch.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Tools adds the capability to configure websites using Visual Studio Code ... Upload: Uploads local changes back to your environment.

claims.claim: The developer signs in to the target environment before using the download and upload workflow.
claims.quote: An authenticated PAC CLI session connected to your target environment. ... An Azure CLI session signed in to the same tenant.

claims.claim: The developer's environment security roles govern access to the Dataverse configuration modified through the CLI.
claims.quote: Your code will only be able to perform operations based on the privileges assigned to the user account through security roles or team membership.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/security-model for the statement that environment roles govern the developer's Dataverse operations.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a plugin-specific tenant admin switch on the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin tenant disable Power Platform API tenant settings PowerShell coding agents. Opened plugin guidance, Copilot hub for Power Pages and List tenant settings; checked pac admin search results. No plugin-specific switch was documented.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Table permissions assigned to web roles control access to Dataverse data.
claims.quote: Table permissions assigned to web roles allow members of the web role to access data that's stored in Dataverse tables.

claims.claim: A permission or web role change can widen site visitors' access to data.
claims.quote: When the Anonymous users web role is granted access to a table, any user who visits the site can access the data in the table.

claims.claim: The workflow introduces a third-party AI coding tool, Claude Code, into Power Pages development.
claims.quote: Anthropic's Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools.

claims.claim: Code sites also use a Power Platform CLI upload and download workflow.
claims.quote: Power Pages SPA sites are managed using the PAC CLI commands upload-code-site and download-code-site.
